Native-unavailable state (contract rule 7) is explicit and documented via exported URL_STATE_NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE_REASON and the file header: the mirrored value lives only in the per-process store, is not reflected in any URL, is not shareable/bookmarkable/restored-on-reload, has no browser history (push/replace no-op, no back-navigation), and does not survive an app restart; within a session all read/write/omitDefault/parse/serialize behavior matches the web hook and every mounted consumer re-renders on change via useSyncExternalStore. The react-router v6 multi-setter race the web hook documents is faithfully reproduced (functional updater receives the current-render params snapshot), so useUrlBatch's reason for existing is preserved rather than silently fixed.

Gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) all pass; baseline was green before the change and remains green after.
